name: Deck of Old Ship
description: You stand on the damp, creaking deck of an old freighter. The air smells of salt, rust, and diesel fumes. The low rumble of the engine vibrates through your boots. A 'sound of distant thunder' echoes ominously. The only visible crew are the captain near the bridge door and a couple of deck hands securing cargo.
visited_description: You are on the deck of the old ship. The captain and deck hands eye you.

interactables.name: case
interactables.description: A sturdy-looking metal supply case rests near some coiled ropes. It looks like standard agency issue.

actions.examine: display_text:It looks like standard military or agency supply issue. Might contain useful gear.

interactables.name: railing
interactables.description: A rusty metal railing lines the edge of the deck.

actions.examine: display_text:It's pitted with rust from the sea air but feels solid. Looking over the side reveals dark, choppy water.
actions.look over: display_text:The waves below look cold and uninviting. The distant island looms.
actions.lean on: display_text:You lean on the railing, feeling the vibration of the engines.

interactables.name: dossier
interactables.description: Your mission briefing dossier lies on a nearby crate.

actions.examine: display_text:Standard issue dossier. Contains the mission briefing.
